items.title: LINZ PositioNZ active GNSS reference network, 2018 illustration
items.dateDisplay: 2018 illustration; current network changes over time
items.caption: LINZ PositioNZ active control network illustration (2018), showing national infrastructure for positioning corrections and continuous satellite-based observations.
items.context: An actual LINZ GNSS network product. It illustrates practical survey positioning services in New Zealand, not the first introduction of handheld GPS.
items.altText: Map or network illustration from LINZ PositioNZ about GPS/GNSS stations in New Zealand.

items.title: Landonline Web Search displaying survey work, 2025
items.caption: LINZ Web Search showing cadastral survey work as parcels, marks and survey vectors, with dimensions and relationships visible in a spatial display.
items.context: An authentic screen from the 2025 web version of Landonline, documented by LINZ. It is not an image of the original 2000s launch interface.
items.altText: Landonline Web Search spatial map showing survey vectors, survey marks and parcel information.

items.title: ArcMap Identify panel with related New Zealand parcel records
items.dateDisplay: Published by LINZ by 2022; example files dated 2016
items.caption: LINZ's ArcMap example showing property records linked through an Esri file geodatabase, including parcels, survey plans, title estates and statutory actions.
items.context: A genuine New Zealand desktop GIS screenshot preserved in a LINZ guide explaining file-geodatabase table relationships. The capture date is not independently confirmed, and it does not purport to show the first desktop GIS rollout.
items.altText: ArcMap desktop geographic information system showing an identified parcel and linked property tables.

items.title: LINZ Data Service WMTS connection configured in QGIS
items.dateDisplay: Date of original screenshot not independently established; LINZ guide current by 2026
items.caption: A LINZ-published QGIS interface used to connect to its Web Map Tile Service (WMTS), an example of spatial information shared as a standardised network service.
items.context: Original software screenshot from LINZ's instructions for consuming nationally available tile services in GIS. The image illustrates standards and interoperable infrastructure, not a historical screen from 1990s SDI planning.
items.altText: QGIS WMTS client or connection panel in a LINZ Data Service tutorial.

items.title: Territorial authority boundaries in Landonline Web Search, 2025
items.caption: Territorial authority boundaries displayed in LINZ Web Search as an additional governmental spatial layer, published in its service release notes.
items.context: A real government spatial data display demonstrating integration of cadastral and territorial-authority boundaries. The screenshot belongs to a 2025 release and should not be used to represent earlier government GIS software.
items.altText: New Zealand territorial authority boundaries overlaid in LINZ Web Search mapping.

items.title: LINZ Data Service imagery accessed through QGIS WMTS
items.dateDisplay: LINZ user-guide screenshot; precise capture date not established
items.caption: QGIS used with the LINZ Data Service WMTS connection, showing the workflow through which downloadable public geospatial information can be served as map layers.
items.context: A screenshot from LINZ's public WMTS guidance. It documents software access to open spatial data and is not an image of the earliest version of the LINZ Data Service.
items.altText: QGIS with a connected LINZ map-tile service in a public-data tutorial.

items.title: LINZ Web Feature Service attribute filtering, 2023
items.dateDisplay: LINZ screenshot stored under a June 2023 media path; capture date unverified
items.caption: A LINZ Data Service WFS example showing request structures and feature-type attribute information used to access geospatial records programmatically.
items.context: Original LINZ tutorial screenshot of a live spatial-service interface or response. It illustrates interoperable APIs and is not the first appearance of web geospatial services in New Zealand.
items.altText: LINZ Web Feature Service filtering or data response example from its developer guidance.

items.credit: Vallee (creator), using LiDAR supplied by LINZ, map labels from Topomap and QGIS/aerialOD cartography. Display derivative resized to WebP; original preserved.
items.title: Kāpiti Island terrain depicted with LINZ LiDAR, 2024
items.caption: Detailed shaded-relief map of Kāpiti Island produced in 2024 by Vallee using publicly available LINZ LiDAR data, QGIS, and aerialOD shading.
items.context: This map is a modern, real LiDAR-derived terrain product. It shows terrain detail possible using high-density elevation measurements; it is not a scan of an early New Zealand LiDAR flight.
items.altText: LiDAR-derived relief map of Kāpiti Island showing terrain, vegetation-shaped relief and mapped place names.
